issues.description: Field name mismatch for the same conceptual attributes: the Problem Statement text (line 17) instructs students to add attributes named 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents', while the UML in the same Problem Statement (lines 65-68) and the Solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 6-10) use the names 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. This inconsistency can confuse students which exact identifier to implement and may cause their code or automated tests (that expect the longer names) to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute names consistent across artifacts. Update the Problem Statement text at line 17 to use 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' to match the UML and the solution (and the tests), or explicitly state that the shorter names ('inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents') are acceptable and will be mapped to the UML names. Ensure examples and the UML use identical identifiers to avoid ambiguous guidance for students.
